title: Lava Floor Penguins
hook: The floor is lava, the fish are falling, and penguins cannot fly. Waddle fast.

theme.keyArtPrompt: Cheerful penguins hopping across glowing orange lava cracks on an ice floe, fish raining from the sky, bold shapes, no text

sprites.player: round penguin with a scarf, top-down cartoon
sprites.lava: bubbling orange lava blob with a warning glow, top-down cartoon

timeline.hostLine: Something big is coming! Watch the sky, everyone!
Ten seconds left and the sky is ANGRY!

host.intro: Grab the goodies, dodge the falling blobs, and slide like you mean it.
host.finale: The dust settles. One player waddles home a champion.
host.tutorial: Stick to move, tap Slide to dash. Grab the goodies, dodge the glowing drops.
